title: So Ra No Wo To OVA
justification: AniList 8197 (OVA, 2 episode(s) from 2010-06-23) is AniDB 6783's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2010-06-23 to 2010-09-22. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 6783. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S2 default to TVDB 0x1-0x2.
